entries.title: The Coma: Cutting Class

emulation.notes: Use the native Recut PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Coma: Recut is the remastered/current version of The Coma: Cutting Class, with upgraded visuals and mechanics; the Windows PC release is the best fidelity/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Coma: Recut on Steam and play the Windows PC build as the main route. Treat the original Cutting Class release as historical only.

entries.remaster_caveats: Recut is a remastered version of Cutting Class with visual and mechanics upgrades. The original release is historical/delisted and not the recommended route.

entries.title: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best fidelity/capture route for The Coma 2, while macOS/Linux, PS4, Xbox One, and Switch have no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters on Steam or GOG and play the Windows PC build. Use console or other desktop builds only for platform preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: Direct sequel, not a remake/remaster of the first game.

entries.title: The Coma 2B: Catacomb
entries.definitive_edition: Steam PC release; Deluxe Edition optional for soundtrack, artbook, and cosmetic skins

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best fidelity/capture route for The Coma 2B: Catacomb, while PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch have no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Coma 2B: Catacomb on Steam and play the Windows PC build. The Deluxe Edition adds extras such as skins, soundtrack, and artbook, but the base PC game is the primary story route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Bridge story set between the first game and The Coma 2, not a remaster. Deluxe extras appear to be non-story add-ons.
